title: Linguistic Holonomy and Statistical Watermarks: Inner Geometry of Meaning-Preserving Transformations
abstract: arXiv:2608.19369v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Statistical watermarks for language models live in the freedom of the signifier: they choose among tokens that are nearly equivalent in meaning, and they are therefore eroded by exactly those transformations which move the form of a text while leaving its content in place. The literature measures such transformations by their endpoint, through the semantic similarity between the original and the rewritten text. We show that the endpoint is the wrong statistic. Adapting the formalism of linguistic loops, we prove that the invariant of a chain of meaning-preserving transformations factorises canonically into an endpoint part and a holonomy in the stabiliser of the initial state, the second of which the semantic deficit cannot see; the loop rotation is parallel transport on the unit sphere of the embedding space, so that the analogy with the Wilson loop becomes a theorem rather than a figure of speech. translated_title: 语言整体性与统计水印：意义保持变换的内在几何
translated_abstract: 统计水印用于语言模型，其存在依赖于能指的自由度：它们在意义上几乎等价的词元之间进行选择，因此，那些在改变文本形式的同时保持其内容不变的变换会侵蚀这些水印。现有文献通过原始文本与改写文本之间的语义相似性，以变换的终点来衡量此类变换。我们表明，终点是错误的统计量。通过采用语言循环的形式体系，我们证明了一系列意义保持变换的不变量可以规范地分解为一个终点部分和一个在初始状态稳定器中的整体性，后者是语义缺陷无法察觉的；循环旋转是嵌入空间单位球面上的平行移动，因此与威尔逊循环的类比成为定理而非修辞。在检测器方面，我们证明了……
tldr: 本文提出语言水印的稳定性应通过意义保持变换链中的整体性（holonomy）而非语义终点来衡量，并证明该整体性等价于嵌入空间中的平行移动，从而为水印检测提供了新的理论框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes that the robustness of language watermarks should be measured by the holonomy in chains of meaning-preserving transformations rather than semantic endpoints, and proves this holonomy equals parallel transport on the embedding sphere, offering a new theoretical framework for watermark detection.
